reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 15 points better, in a game of about 233 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Kings.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Kings (revenge).
Bottom line: the Lakers win 87 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 206 and 255 total points.

analyst.text: Sacramento are 1-13 after a franchise-first 0-7 homestand, Doug Christie is in the last fully secured year of his deal and says 'the seat is hot, always', and Domantas Sabonis had a visible exchange with Zach LaVine on Wednesday. The Lakers had a nine-game winning streak ended in Utah and Austin Reaves (heel) is day-to-day after an encouraging workout. A Lakers side wanting a response against a fractured opponent: the angle leans clearly towards Los Angeles.
